[Hi, my name is Melanie]{.fs-3} &mdash;
On this blog I write about sustainable agriculture and food security, policies for equitable trade and development, and about the geopolitics of natural resources. You will also find book and article reviews, and the occasional shout-out and opinion pieces. 

As a [consultant]{.mark .bg-info-subtle}, [designer]{.mark .bg-info-subtle}, and [instructor]{.mark .bg-info-subtle}, I specialize in helping research teams and businesses effectively harness data, build  models, and communicate insights through engaging visuals.

I code mostly in [R]{.bg-info-subtle}, [Python]{.bg-info-subtle}, [JavaScript]{.bg-info-subtle} and [D3.js]{.bg-info-subtle}. Check out my [full bio](./posts/resume/) for contact details.
:::
